parameters.content:
## Flujo creado para poder realizar un tracking Request
Esto es de ejemplo para la implementación previa al Weebhook

## Ejemplos utilizados de BLs:
MEDUFM228344
MEDUFM228047
QGD2885433
HLCUMVD260407232
HLCUSS5260478045
HLCUMVD260600083

## Requerimientos minimos para poder realizar el HTTP Request a Terminal 49
SCAC y MBL. 
Se va a realizar una posible implementación para determinar el SCAC del embarque.

## Mandatory Headers para SafeCube
Host: api.sinay.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 411

## Cambiar el MBL no requiere nada aquí
Este flujo **no guarda estado por `tracking_key`**: lo relee de `v_active_shipments_for_tracking` en cada corrida y actualiza por `shipment_id`.

Si el portal corrige el MBL de un embarque, la clave vieja deja de consultarse sola y la nueva entra en el siguiente sondeo.

El webhook ignora su cuerpo: es solo un «recorre todos ahora». Refresco selectivo pendiente — ver punto 7 de `docs/pendientes-coordinacion-compras-internacionales.md`.

/** Update international_purchases.shipments **/
UPDATE international_purchases.shipments
SET
  eta = COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'null')::date, eta),
  etd = COALESCE(NULLIF($2,'null')::date, etd),
  atd = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'null')::date, atd),
  ata = COALESCE(NULLIF($4,'null')::date, ata),

  /** shipment_status y shipment_type vienen tal cual de SafeCube y la tabla tiene
      CHECK sobre ambos: shipment_status IN (PLANNED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, UNKNOWN)
      y shipment_type IN (CT, BL, BK, DC). Un valor nuevo de la API reventaba el
      UPDATE COMPLETO con error 23514 y se perdian tambien las fechas. Ahora un valor
      desconocido simplemente se ignora y se conserva el anterior. **/
  shipment_status = CASE
    WHEN NULLIF($5,'null') IN ('PLANNED','IN_TRANSIT','DELIVERED','UNKNOWN') THEN $5
    ELSE shipment_status
  END,
  shipment_type = CASE
    WHEN NULLIF($19,'null') IN ('CT','BL','BK','DC') THEN $19
    ELSE shipment_type
  END,

  terminal = COALESCE(NULLIF($6,'null'), terminal),
  warnings = COALESCE((SELECT ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($7::jsonb))), '{}'::text[]),
  last_tracking_error = NULL,
  last_tracking_error_at = NULL,

  /** updated_at es NOT NULL. Si SafeCube no manda metadata.updatedAt, la expresion
      anterior evaluaba a NULL y el UPDATE fallaba entero con error 23502. El COALESCE
      conserva el valor previo en ese caso. **/
  updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF($18, ''), 'null')::timestamptz, updated_at)
WHERE shipment_id = $9;

/** Historial: solo si hubo un cambio real de fecha **/
INSERT INTO international_purchases.shipment_tracking_history (
  shipment_id,
  tracking_key,
  field_name,
  old_date_value,
  new_date_value,
  tracking_source,
  tracking_status,
  raw_tracking_payload,
  audit_execution_id,
  n8n_execution_id
)
SELECT
  $9::uuid,
  $8,
  $10,
  NULLIF($11,'null')::TIMESTAMPTZ,
  NULLIF($12,'null')::TIMESTAMPTZ,
  $13,
  $14,
  NULLIF($17,'null')::jsonb,
  $15,
  $16
WHERE NULLIF($10,'null') IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_execution (
  execution_id,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  n8n_workflow_id,
  business_key,
  trigger_type,
  trigger_source,
  source_system,
  process_code
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $workflow.name }}',
  'STARTED',
  '{{ $workflow.id }}',
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  'Schedule and Webhook TRIGGER',
  'FROM international_purchases.shipments',
  'DATABASE',
  'international_purchases'
)
ON CONFLICT (execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
  workflow_name = EXCLUDED.workflow_name,
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  n8n_workflow_id = EXCLUDED.n8n_workflow_id,
  business_key = EXCLUDED.business_key,
  trigger_type = EXCLUDED.trigger_type,
  trigger_source = EXCLUDED.trigger_source,
  source_system = EXCLUDED.source_system,
  process_code = EXCLUDED.process_code,
  updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, error_message, payload
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF($audit${{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}$audit$, ''), 'null'), 'undefined'),
    'ERR-' || gen_random_uuid()::text
  ),
  'ERROR',
  'Error de tracking (embarque)',
  'GET Shipment',
  'ERROR',
  'WARNING',
  $audit${{ "Error: " + $json.parsedMessage.errorCode + " " + $json.parsedMessage.details }}$audit$,
  $audit${{ JSON.stringify($json.parsedMessage) }}$audit$::jsonb;

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, payload
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}',
  'API Request',
  'GET Shipment hacia API safecube endpoint /shipment',
  'GET Shipment',
  'SUCCESS', 'INFO',
  $audit${{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata) }}$audit$::jsonb
);

WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF($audit${{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}$audit$, ''), 'null'), 'undefined'),
      'ERR-' || gen_random_uuid()::text
    ) AS execution_id,
    $audit${{ $workflow.name }}$audit$ AS workflow_name,
    $audit${{ $workflow.id }}$audit$ AS n8n_workflow_id,
    $audit${{ JSON.stringify({ cierre_tecnico: true, mensaje: "Flujo finalizado de actualización de ETA", ultimo_nodo: "UPDATE ETA And Dates", closed_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}$audit$::jsonb AS final_event_payload
),
ensure_execution_success AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.workflow_execution (
    execution_id, workflow_name, status, n8n_workflow_id,
    business_key, trigger_type, source_system, process_code, completed_at
  )
  SELECT
    execution_id, workflow_name, 'SUCCESS', n8n_workflow_id,
    execution_id, 'SafeCube', 'API', 'international_purchases', NOW()
  FROM ctx
  ON CONFLICT (execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
    workflow_name   = EXCLUDED.workflow_name,
    status          = 'SUCCESS',
    n8n_workflow_id = EXCLUDED.n8n_workflow_id,
    process_code    = 'international_purchases',
    error_message   = NULL,
    error_payload   = NULL,
    completed_at    = COALESCE(audit.workflow_execution.completed_at, NOW()),
    updated_at      = NOW()
  RETURNING execution_id
)
INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, payload
)
SELECT
  ensure_execution_success.execution_id,
  'END', 'Flujo finalizado correctamente', 'AUDIT Éxito Final',
  'SUCCESS', 'INFO', ctx.final_event_payload
FROM ensure_execution_success
CROSS JOIN ctx;

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, payload
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}',
  'UPDATE DB',
  'UPDATE Exitoso hacia tabla international_purchases.shipments',
  'UPDATE ETA And Dates',
  'SUCCESS', 'INFO',
  $audit${{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, tracking_key: $json.tracking_key ?? null }) }}$audit$::jsonb
);

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, error_message, payload
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF($audit${{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}$audit$, ''), 'null'), 'undefined'),
    'ERR-' || gen_random_uuid()::text
  ),
  'ERROR',
  'Error en UPDATE ETA And Dates (embarque)',
  'UPDATE ETA And Dates',
  'ERROR',
  'WARNING',
  $audit${{ '[' + ($json.tracking_key ?? 'SIN_TRACKING_KEY') + '] ' + ($json.error?.description ?? $json.message ?? '') }}$audit$,
  $audit${{ JSON.stringify($json) }}$audit$::jsonb;

INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, payload
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}',
  'SELECT',
  $audit$SELECT exitoso: {{ $('SELECT FROM v_active_shipment_for_tracking').all().length }} embarques activos$audit$,
  'SELECT FROM v_active_shipment_for_tracking',
  'SUCCESS', 'INFO',
  $audit${{ JSON.stringify({ count: $('SELECT FROM v_active_shipment_for_tracking').all().length }) }}$audit$::jsonb
);

WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF($audit${{ $('Set Request_ID').first().json.request_id }}$audit$, ''), 'null'), 'undefined'),
      'ERR-' || gen_random_uuid()::text
    ) AS execution_id,
    $audit${{ $workflow.name }}$audit$ AS workflow_name,
    $audit${{ $workflow.id }}$audit$ AS n8n_workflow_id,
    $audit${{ "Error en SELECT FROM v_active_shipment_for_tracking: [" + ($json.error?.level ?? '') + "] " + ($json.error?.description ?? '') }}$audit$ AS error_message,
    $audit${{ $json.mensaje_operador ?? $json.mensaje ?? $json.error?.message ?? "Error desconocido" }}$audit$ AS event_error_message,
    $audit${{ JSON.stringify($json) }}$audit$::jsonb AS error_payload
),
upsert_execution AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.workflow_execution (
    execution_id, workflow_name, status, n8n_workflow_id,
    trigger_type, source_system, process_code,
    error_message, error_payload, completed_at
  )
  SELECT
    execution_id, workflow_name, 'ERROR', n8n_workflow_id,
    'SELECT DB', 'PostgreSQL', 'international_purchases',
    error_message, error_payload, NOW()
  FROM ctx
  ON CONFLICT (execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
    workflow_name   = EXCLUDED.workflow_name,
    status          = 'ERROR',
    n8n_workflow_id = EXCLUDED.n8n_workflow_id,
    process_code    = EXCLUDED.process_code,
    completed_at    = NOW(),
    error_message   = EXCLUDED.error_message,
    error_payload   = EXCLUDED.error_payload,
    updated_at      = NOW()
  RETURNING execution_id
)
INSERT INTO audit.workflow_events (
  execution_id, event_type, event_name, node_name,
  status, event_level, error_message, payload
)
SELECT
  upsert_execution.execution_id,
  'ERROR', 'Error EN SELECT', 'SELECT FROM v_active_shipment_for_tracking',
  'ERROR', 'ERROR',
  ctx.event_error_message, ctx.error_payload
FROM upsert_execution
CROSS JOIN ctx;

UPDATE international_purchases.shipments
SET last_tracking_error = NULLIF($1,'null')::jsonb,
    last_tracking_error_at = NOW()
WHERE shipment_id = $2;
